pro_course_detail.title: CAE/FCE  Speaking mock exam
pro_course_detail.description:
We will do a mock exam so that you can be more comfortable when you finally take the test.
Part 1 Interview: The examiner asks questions and you may have to give information about your interests, studies, careers, etc. You have to give information about yourself and expressing your opinion about various topics.

Part 2. The long turn. The examiner gives you three pictures and asks you to talk about two of them. You have to speak for 1 minute without interruption and the interlocutor then asks the other candidate to comment on what you have said for about 30 seconds. The other candidate receives a different set of photographs and you have to listen and comment when they have finished speaking. The questions you have to answer about your photographs are written at the top of the page to remind you what you should talk about.

Part 3: Conversation with the other candidate. The examiner gives you spoken instructions with written prompts which are used in a discussion. You have to talk with the other candidate for about 2 minutes (3 minutes for groups of three) about the written prompts. After the discussion time, the examiner will ask you another question which requires you to make a decision. You have 1 minute to talk together and make the decision (2 minutes for groups of three).

Part 4: Further discussion with the other candidate based on the topics or issues raised in the task in Part 3. The interlocutor asks each of you some questions and you discuss them with the other candidate.

pro_course_detail.title: "Beginner's Guide to Learning Cebuano"
pro_course_detail.description:
Kumusta, higala! Ako nagtudlo sa Cebuano, ang labing prominente nga diyalekto human sa Tagalog sa Pilipinas, diin minilyones ka mga nagasulti. Labaw pa niini, importante usab nga tandaan ang kasayuran sa pagkakaiba sa Cebuano ug Visayan. Ang Cebuano usa ka daghang gisulti nga pinulongan sa rehiyon sa Cebu ug ubang bahin sa Mindanao. Usa kini ka importante nga diyalekto sulod sa pamilya sa pinulongang Visayan. Ang Visayan, sa pikas bahin, usa ka pangtugmang termino nga nagaapil sa daghang pinulongan nga gisulti sa rehiyon sa Visayas, lakip na ang Cebuano, Hiligaynon (Ilonggo), Waray, ug uban pa. Maghiusa kita sa pagtuon sa pinulongan, ug pinaagi sa atong pagtinabangay, mahimong mas mapalambo pa nato ang atong kaalam ug abilidad sa pag-ila sa pinulongan sa Cebuano.


ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
Hello friend! I teach Cebuano, the most prominent dialect spoken after Tagalog in the Philippines, with millions of speakers. Additionally, it's important to note the difference between Cebuano and Visayan. Cebuano is a major language spoken in the Cebu region and various parts of Mindanao. It's a significant dialect within the Visayan language family. On the other hand, Visayan is an umbrella term encompassing several languages spoken across the Visayas region, including Cebuano, Hiligaynon (Ilonggo), Waray, and others. Let's join together in learning the language, and through our collaboration, we can further enrich our knowledge and proficiency in the Cebuano language.
